Tram Knowledge

Instructions:  Below are several descriptions dealing with what you know about the tram line. Please use the scale below to rate each.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

____ 1. I know the tram timetable.

____ 2. I do not know where the tram stops.

____ 3. The tram fares are clear to me.

____ 4. I do not understand the tram zones.

____ 5. I could explain the tram route to a visitor.

Recode: 2 & 4

Score should be between 5 and 25
